Sparse color points outside\\n    # the panels are the pattern to be copied into each panel interior.\\n    from collections import Counter\\n    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v)\\n    boxes=[]\\n    for color,n in cnt.items():\\n        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]\\n        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)\\n        if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2: continue\\n        if all(grid[r0][c]==color and grid[r1][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[r][c0]==color and grid[r][c1]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1)):\\n            boxes.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,color))\\n    # Only outlined frames whose boundary color itself is not noisy singleton marker.\\n    for r0,r1,c0,c1,color in boxes:\\n        for r in range(r0,r1+1):\\n            for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[r][c]=grid[r][c]\\n    # Small objects (distinct from frames) serve as stamps; reproduce each stamp\\n    # inside the nearest/largest frame, expanded by its literal pixel pattern.\\n    frames=sorted(boxes,key=lambda b:(b[1]-b[0])*(b[3]-b[2]),reverse=True)\\n    if not frames: return out\\n    # Choose small closed object(s) from the scene; grid task's stamps are outlined\\n    # color objects and are copied into the interior of the other panels.\\n    frame_colors={b[4] for b in boxes}\\n    for r0,r1,c0,c1,fc in boxes:\\n        interior_h=r1-r0-1; interior_w=c1-c0-1\\n        stamps=[b for b in boxes if b[4]!=fc]\\n        if stamps:\\n            b=min(stamps,key=lambda b:(b[1]-b[0]+1)*(b[3]-b[2]+1))\\n            br0,br1,bc0,bc1,sc=b\\n            pat=[[grid[r][c]==sc for c in range(bc0,bc1+1)] for r in range(br0,br1+1)]\\n            for r in range(interior_h):\\n                for c in range(interior_w):\\n                    if pat[r%len(pat)][c%len(pat[0])]: out[r0+1+r][c0+1+c]=sc\\n    return out\\n''')\"",
